panel.title: Codex usage
panel.today_budget_note: Allowance left ÷ local calendar days until reset.
panel.warn_fixed: Warn: weekly usage reached the fixed threshold.

bar_metric.description: Whether the bar shows leftover or used percentage for the selected window.
bar_metric.label: Bar percentage

bar_window.description: Which allowance window's percentage appears on the bar.
bar_window.label: Bar window

refresh_minutes.description: Minutes between usage checks. The panel refresh button checks immediately.
refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval (minutes)

show_credits.description: Show the Credits section in the panel when the API returns credit data.
show_credits.label: Show credits

weekly_warn_mode.description: Controls bar color when weekly allowance pace is high. Does not change which percentage the bar shows.
weekly_warn_mode.label: Weekly warn mode

weekly_warn_percent.description: When warn mode is Fixed, warn once weekly used reaches this percentage.
weekly_warn_percent.label: Weekly warn percent

status.expired: Codex login expired. Run codex login again.
status.missing_auth: Sign in with codex login so this can read Codex allowance.
status.partial: Some usage data is missing or outdated.
status.unauthorized: Codex rejected the saved login. Run codex login again.
